verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs say every endpoint reference page publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec inline, referencing versioned JSON spec files (e.g. specs/2026-09/account-account-info-v2026-09.json), and the docs are agent-readable via /docs/llms.txt and .md page variants. The probe 404s only hit guessed root paths (/openapi.json, /llms.txt), not the documented locations, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: evidence of a single consolidated, directly downloadable spec covering the whole API (specs appear per-endpoint), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec JSON files can actually be fetched.
